Final report — A2780 / A2780cis new data

The analysis on one page: the data, the compartment models used at every stage, their bootstrapping, sensitivity analysis and validation, and optimal control of the cisplatin schedule built on them, over 14 days (and, beyond the data, 30 and 60 days), a sweep over the control's modelling decisions, and, with fasting as a second control, over 120 days (read off at days 14, 30, 60 and 120). The modelling decisions of this version come first, next to the previous version. Earlier time-based models are kept only in the time-based archive. Each chapter is the full report for that step (assembled 2026-10-27 17:04); the date under each heading is when that report was last generated. Rebuild with julia build_final_report.jl.
